name: adapt-ab-navigation
description: An interface/adapter over the whole core navigation bar (.nav): stamps a .ab.navigation hook for token-driven restyling (--ab-base-navigation-*), emits abNavigation:ready with the button inventory + label mode, and injects author-configured custom nav items into .nav__inner (ordered; can trigger a core data-event, open an adapt-ab-modal, or be a link). Pairs with adapt-ab-navbtn. Renders no region of its own; dependency-free.
